en.joke: My therapist told me to embrace detachment. So I left my phone on silent for an hour. The existential dread was immaculate.
en.explanation: It's a dry, ironic take on modern phone dependency and the anxiety of disconnecting, using internet slang ('immaculate').

people.name: Jean-Baptiste Colbert
people.extract: Jean-Baptiste Colbert was a French statesman who served as First Minister of State from 1661 until his death in 1683 under the rule of King Louis XIV. His lasting impact on the organization of the country's politics and markets, known as Colbertism, a doctrine often characterized as a variant of mercantilism, earned him the nickname le Grand Colbert.
highlights: Served as First Minister of State under King Louis XIV.
Created Colbertism, a doctrine impacting politics and markets.

people.name: Kevin Kaesviharn
people.extract: Kevin Robert Kaesviharn is an American former professional football player who was a safety in the National Football League (NFL). He was signed by the Iowa Barnstormers as a street free agent in 1998. He played college football for the Augustana Vikings.
highlights: Former professional football safety in the NFL.
Signed by Iowa Barnstormers as a street free agent.
Played college football for the Augustana Vikings.

people.name: Néstor Araujo
people.extract: Néstor Alejandro Araujo Razo is a Mexican professional footballer who plays as a centre-back. He is an Olympic gold medalist.
highlights: Mexican professional footballer, plays as centre-back.
